gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-cham: Huge round bowls on every lowercase letter give Bloody its commanding swagger, while Noto Sans Cham stays out of the way. Paragraphs of it move along smoothly, open and rounded.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Loud, round-bellied lowercase that means business, courtesy of Bloody. Noto Sans Cherokee, plain sans with short stalks and a wide-gapped e, makes extended reading feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Bloody swings in with big round lowercase bowls, over Noto Sans Devanagari, a compact plain sans with an open-tailed g. Loud meets quiet, and neither one ever competes for attention.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Noto Sans Gujarati is a clean, modern sans-serif. Its curves stop before turning inward and its counters stay large, so text keeps moving easily beneath the commanding Bloody heading.
gen-dafont-brusher-plus-jakarta-sans: Romantic, calligraphic flourish: Brusher draws curves fat as cord and keeps its e wide open. And Plus Jakarta Sans, monoline and precise, keeps its tidy endings apart, best for brief text.
gen-dafont-burnstown-dam-fs-karma: Karma is a trustworthy serif whose terminals finish well away from the stem, under the closed, geometric Burnstown Dam. Its mild modulation keeps paragraphs of text smooth and unsnagged.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-abeezee: Wide-spaced and shade-free, Bushcraft looks like pure artistic impulse. ABeeZee, plain sans with a high mean line and open terminals, gives that exuberance a friendly, tubelike partner to stand beside.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-anek-bangla: Spaced-out, single-track lettering that hums like a neon sign. Bushcraft is made for expressive display moments, while Anek Bangla, a sans with wide s curves, handles the everyday text.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Expressive, widely spaced, with capitals that barely stand out. Bushcraft is best at expressive flair, whereas Noto Sans Chakma, a sans with open s and c mouths, is best at steady reading.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac Western reads modern and clean, its terminals held back. Next to the wire-thick, widely spaced Bushcraft heading, longer text feels light and open instead of dense.
